limitations: Same selected trader retrospective public ledger, not independent forward sample.
An order can mix first open and subsequent adds; pure-open label excludes initial entries.
Source future price is Binance candle close at floor(last fill minute)+5min; whole-order VWAP known after fills. Not exactly five minutes after first fill.
Postfill direction return cannot establish TP1-first or emergency warning.
No rule-based counterfactual/unfilled orders/native quotes; no causal maker advantage.
10/20bp sensitivity is not full funding/slippage doublecost.
All source rows retained, missing paths not liquidated; dynamic overlapping inventory means orders are not independent trades.
